recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Future MPHO profile maturity changes should be made in HL7/oo-incubator unless a later work-group decision moves the profile back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-49802 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking that the MedicalProductOfHumanOrigin core profile maturity level be moved to FMM 1.
initial_application: Commit e310a0cfa367251d83d375ce0ca75c3286ef3473, merged by HL7/fhir#3327 as 67f1afa39d79c7246d74b47c8ac545abd018c4a1, changed source/biologicallyderivedproduct/structuredefinition-profile-medicalproductofhumanorigin.xml from structuredefinition-fmm 5 to 1.
additional_context: Later OO decisions FHIR-52021 and FHIR-54998 concluded that the MPHO profile should be removed from FHIR core and moved to the OO Incubator IG. Current core source has no active fhir.ini profile entry for medicalproductofhumanorigin, the BiologicallyDerivedProduct core ImplementationGuide no longer references StructureDefinition/medicalproductofhumanorigin, and the profile source file is absent. The successor HL7/oo-incubator FSH profile declares structuredefinition-fmm valueInteger = 1.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The requested maturity value was already applied, and the current core build no longer contains or owns the MPHO profile source that would need an FMM edit.

related_jiras.note: The same HL7/fhir#3327 implementation changed Observation/Vital Signs profile FMM values, but that is separate Observation scope and was not decided here.
Later OO decision resolved to remove the MPHO profile from core and move it to the OO Incubator IG.
Later OO decision explicitly requested removing the BDP MPHO profile from FHIR core after the incubator work.
